dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Miki needs at risk placement for medical reasons. She is a sweet senior girl with diabetes mellitus. She needs outpatient management of her condition with a local veterinarian and placement in a quiet home to enjoy her days.

A volunteer writes:
Ten year old altered Miki and Gordon were brought to the Manhattan Care Center as their ailing and elderly owner could not take care of them anymore. Both are quite overweight and said to be good pets. Miki is a pretty dame with lovely eyes(Gordon, her sibling, owns just the same..)who lays calmly in her oversized kennel, a bit uneasy looking but curious of my presence. Her tail flicks a little. She might think:here they are again, trying to "do things to me"... Indeed, Miki is a newly diagnosed diabetic kitty. She relaxes when she realizes that I am only visiting for a chat and some cuddles and so, she leans into pets and purrs(see her video). Miki is a lovely and sweet ladycat. We are hoping for her to find a quiet and loving home, knowledgeable in the management of diabetic cats and looking forward to help a senior.
dog.name: Miki
